title: An "As of" indicator names the day actually shown when it is earlier than the date asked for, and is hidden when they match
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. A past date exists that has NO snapshot of its own but has an earlier recorded day before it (for example, a gap day, or a date in the thinned monthly-retention band).
custom_steps:
1. Select a Custom range ending on the gap date (a date with no snapshot of its own).
2. Look for an "As of" indicator and read which day it names.
3. Then select a range ending on a day that IS recorded (or today with live values) and look for the indicator again.
custom_expected:
1. When the displayed day is an earlier recorded day than the date asked for, the report shows an "As of" indicator naming the day actually shown.
2. When the displayed day matches the date asked for (the common current-view case), the "As of" indicator is not shown — the date control already communicates the date.
